interpretation: retrospective and exploratory; original frozen evaluation unchanged
model_fitting: none; existing saved forecasts and model inference only
fast_change_stratum: absolute observed target-to-previous-10-minute generation difference > 200.001 kW; offline scoring only

uncertainty.one_sided_width: infinite upper endpoint; report nominal-minus-lower offset separately

oracle_warning: Perfect forecasts are nondeployable; finite-horizon composite MPC is not a mathematical upper bound on every realised metric

development_design.reason: chronological spread with all static calibration targets strictly before the first decision; no holdout performance selection
development_design.runtime_policy: pilot and estimate first; any reduced prefix or incomplete run must be explicitly recorded, never relabelled as full episodes

retrospective_evaluation.blocks: original 49 scheduled evaluation blocks, excluding development block 6
retrospective_evaluation.known_overlap: block 6 development targets share five block 7 scored h1 target timestamps

statistics.method: paired non-circular moving-block resampling within each original contiguous segment
statistics.interval_method: recentered basic: observed minus quantiles of bootstrap statistic minus bootstrap mean; approximate, conditional on declared segmentation
statistics.gap_rule: never form an original resampling block across a segment gap
statistics.short_segment_rule: use min(requested_length, segment_length); flag segments with only one available complete block
estimands: total paired difference for the fixed exposure
statistics.limits: conditional exploratory uncertainty under within-segment stationarity and limited dependence assumptions; not restored confirmatory independence

output_policy: exclusive new output directories; checksums, timing, solver failures and configs saved; no overwrite of original results
